ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is used to restrict the user from editing or creating Rebate Type for Under Revision or Approved Sales Agreement.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c ) , NOT( OR( AND( ISCHANGED( Status ) , ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Active') , ISPICKVAL( RebateProgram.PMC_SS_SalesAgreement__r.Status , 'Activated') ), AND( ISCHANGED( Status ) , ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Inactive') , ISPICKVAL( RebateProgram.PMC_SS_SalesAgreement__r.Status , 'Expired') ) ) ),
NOT(ISPICKVAL( RebateProgram.PMC_SS_SalesAgreement__r.Status , 'Cancelled')), OR( ISPICKVAL( RebateProgram.PMC_SS_SalesAgreement__r.PMC_SS_ApprovalStatus__c , 'Approved'), ISPICKVAL( RebateProgram.PMC_SS_SalesAgreement__r.PMC_SS_ApprovalStatus__c , 'Under Revision') ),
OR((PRIORVALUE( PMC_SS_Projected_Incentive__c ) = PMC_SS_Projected_Incentive__c) ,ISBLANK(PMC_SS_Projected_Incentive__c)),
OR((PRIORVALUE( PMC_SS_Forecasted_Quantity__c ) = PMC_SS_Forecasted_Quantity__c) ,ISBLANK(PMC_SS_Forecasted_Quantity__c))
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Rebate Type can’t be created/edited at this stage. Please Amend the Sales Agreement to make revisions to Rebate Type.
